<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex19112023-09-15-125911" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (15b2-16a3) (p. 684:2-685:3)"/>
         <lb n="15b7"/> <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4616">dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs rnal 'byor bcu gnyis pa</rs> zhes bya ba 'di ni | dpal rdo rje <pb n="16a"/><lb n="16a1"/> 'dzin pa gnyis pa dpal ldan <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3905">bla ma dam pa kun spangs pa chen po</rs> <note type="gloss">thugs rje rtson khrus</note>'i zhabs kyi rdul dri ma med pa spyi bos len pa | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4608">shakya'i dge slong shes <lb n="16a2"/> rab 'bum bdag</rs> gis bla ma dam pa nyid kyi phyag len bzhin | bla ma dam pa'i gsung dang gdams pa la brten nas <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5654">dpal <note type="gloss">byo°°</note> nags rgyal gyi dben gnas dkar leb</rs> du sbyar <lb n="16a3"/> ba 'di yongs su rdzogs s+ho || || dge'o ||</seg></TEI>
